# dude

> Cubocicloide's project scaffolding and code-quality CLI. You pick a stack; dude
> scaffolds the project, then enforces its structural conventions mechanically
> with `dude lint` — so an agent working in a dude project can verify its own
> output instead of guessing the conventions.

This file is generated by `make docs-data`. Machine-readable entry points first.

## Start here (machine-readable)

- [Stack index](/stacks/): every stack, with a comparison matrix.
- [airflow (JSON)](/stacks/airflow.json): An Apache Airflow project — organized DAGs & plugins, native or Entra ID SSO, optional AWS ECS Fargate IaC.
- [fastmcp (JSON)](/stacks/fastmcp.json): A FastMCP (Python) server — modular MCP feature sub-servers, with optional AWS ECS Fargate IaC.
- [frappe (JSON)](/stacks/frappe.json): A Frappe Framework ticketing system (Frappe Helpdesk) with a worked custom-app example and optional AWS ECS Fargate IaC.
- [react-django (JSON)](/stacks/react-django.json): React (Vite) frontend with a Django REST Framework backend — optional S3 storage and AWS ECS Fargate IaC.
- [react-fastapi (JSON)](/stacks/react-fastapi.json): React (Vite) frontend with a FastAPI backend — Postgres, Celery and AWS EKS when you need them.
- [tauri (JSON)](/stacks/tauri.json): A Tauri 2 desktop app — React + Ant Design frontend, Rust backend, with iOS/Android targets.

## Inside a scaffolded project

Two commands answer almost everything, and both take `--format json`:

- `dude cheatsheet --format json` — the project’s live command catalog, every
  lint rule with its code and title, the verify loop, and the init answers.
  One call; prefer it over reading the site.
- `dude help --format json` — the merged command catalog on its own (core +
  active stack + project-local commands under `.dude/commands/`).

Each lint rule has prose at `.claude/rules/<GROUP>/<NNN>.md` in the project,
explaining why it exists and how to fix a violation. Read that before working
around a diagnostic.
